query: 投票权差异 投票权差异 衡量企业表决权配置与经济所有权的一致性程度。重点考察差异化投票权架构（如双重股权）的复杂程度、是否存在对中小股东的实质性不公平以及抵消性保护机制。 一、架构公平性评分 (权重 70%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越/高分）：严格执行一股一票制；公司章程明确所有股份具有同等法律地位；无任何差异化投票安排。 • 1分（合格/中分）：存在适度的差异化架构（如 1:10 及以内的投票权倍数）；通常用于保护初创团队的控制权，且该架构已在主流证券交易所合规备案。 • 0分（不合格/低分）：存在极高杠杆的投票差异（如超过 1:20 的表决权比例）或金字塔持股结构；控制权与所有权严重背离；存在“黄金股”等赋予特定人无限否决权的安排。 二、抵消性保护机制 (权重 30%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（完善）：具备强制性的“日落条款”（如创始人离职或特定年限后自动失效）；在涉及并购、章程修改等重大事项时强制执行一股一票；由普通股东独立选派特定比例的独董。 • 1分（基础）：具备基础的保护机制（如相关关联交易需经无利害关系股东批准），但缺乏自动退出（日落）机制或重大事项的穿透表决权。 • 0分（缺失）：没有任何抵消性安排，控股股东或创始人拥有不受限的永久特权。 一股一票 同股同权 股份法律地位平等 投票权差异 差异化表决权 投票权倍数 日落条款 重大事项一股一票 控制权与所有权偏离 同股不同权保护机制 WVR one share one vote equal voting rights equal legal status of shares voting rights disparity dual-class structure voting multiple sunset clause one-share-one-vote on reserved matters ownership-control divergence weighted voting rights WVR minority shareholder protection 企业是否严格执行一股一票，章程是否明确所有股份具有同等法律地位？ 若存在差异化投票权，其股份类别、投票倍数和控制安排是什么？ 是否有日落条款或失效条件？ 重大事项是否强制恢复一股一票？ 普通股东或中小股东有哪些抵消性保护？ 是否存在黄金股或过高杠杆表决安排？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '投票权差异'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 企业是否严格执行一股一票，章程是否明确所有股份具有同等法律地位？ 若存在差异化投票权，其股份类别、投票倍数和控制安排是什么？ 是否有日落条款或失效条件？ 重大事项是否强制恢复一股一票？ 普通股东或中小股东有哪些抵消性保护？ 是否存在黄金股或过高杠杆表决安排？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅声明重视股东权益而无股份类别或表决权依据；仅有独董人数、分红政策或未说明投票权的股权激励；未经章程、股本结构或上市文件支持的一股一票口号。区分：本指标接受严格一股一票作为2分证据，也评估差异架构的投票倍数、日落条款和保护机制；第43项侧重是否同股同权，本项侧重差异程度与抵消保护。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE EMPLOYER / Compensation and benefits

[Content]
Ju Teng International established a legal and incentive-based salary and welfare system in accordance with laws and regulations to make distribution on the basis of performance, provide equal pay for equal work, and ensure employees receive reasonable and legitimate remuneration. In addition, Ju Teng International has developed an employee share award plan. This is to reward eligible participants who have made outstanding contributions to the construction and development of the Group and to attract suitable talents to join the Group and promote its further development.

results.section: RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE EMPLOYER / Compensation and benefits
results.text: Ju Teng International strictly follow the 'Labour Law of the People's Republic of China' and established internal policies and systems such as 'Working Time and Remuneration Management Procedures' and 'Personnel Administrative Systems and Related Norms', and employees are provided with reasonable and appropriate rest time during normal working hours. The Group persists in not forcing any employees to work overtime and adopt an appropriate rest system. According to the internal 'Management Procedure for Employees' Shared Benefits', the Group provide annual leave, paid sick leave and other legal holidays for employees; male employees are entitled to paid paternity leave; employees in special jobs, such as smashers and grain pumpers, are entitled to special subsidies.

results.section: RESPONSIBILITY FOR ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION / Energy management
results.text: Purchased electricity, natural gas and diesel are the main types of energy consumed by Ju Teng International in the course of production and operation. Ju Teng International has systematically strengthened the management of energy use through the 'Energy and Resource Management Procedure'. By adopting environmentally and socially friendly measures which are technically feasible and economically viable, we have actively updated our internal management regulations on energy use and mobilised all employees to save energy and reduce consumption. During the Reporting Period, the Compal Production Plant has adopted scientific methods to formulate production quota assessment and fully motivate the staff to save energy and reduce consumption through the combination of assessment and reward and punishment system. According to the load change and operation condition of the equipment, the characteristics of frequency conversion control technology are used to carry out energy-saving technical transformation of some equipment running at low load, which has achieved a power saving rate of about 30%. Meanwhile, all plants adopt green lighting to reduce energy consumption.
